name: split-editor-diff-viewer
title: Split Editor Diff Viewer
description: Side-by-side code diff viewer layout with line number gutters and addition/deletion styling.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Split
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Diff Line Gutter Inspection: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
